measurements.text:
HOW TO PLAY

How to play

One world, at your pace

Explore on screen. Make real meeting decisions separately.

Move around
Touch
Drag the movement joystick and release to stop. Tap a walkable spot on the map to walk toward it. Dragging the map is not a walk command.
Keyboard
Focus the map or movement joystick. Use arrow keys or W, A, S, D to move. Release the keys to stop; Escape cancels movement.
Explore a place
Choose a nearby interaction in the labeled list, then use Interact, or press E while the map or joystick is focused. Map → place details also works without precise canvas input.

Movement pauses while a panel or text field is active, when the world is hidden, or when focus leaves the controls. It does not resume until you give fresh input.

Look around

Zoom in and Zoom out change the local view. Recenter follows your avatar again; R also recenters while a movement control is focused. Show on map changes the camera only, without moving your avatar.

A release mismatch pauses map targets. Return to the world and reload the current map and places; do not follow an old marker.

Virtual is not physical

A virtual concept is a game landmark, never a verified physical meeting de
